proofs.text: Run the update with `--yes` on each fixture and verify the config reads `version` equal to the `VERSION` file, `gate` `tested`, `ai_review_at` `never`, `min_strength` 50, `mutation_engine` `auto`, `sql_engine` null, `ci` `github` and `pre_push` either `on` or `off`; verify the fixture carried at least one retired key before and that none is present after

rule_text: The config the run leaves is the gate and what the gate derives, carrying `version`, `gate`, `ai_review_at`, `ci`, `min_strength`, `sql_engine`, `mutation_engine`, `test_framework`, `digest` and `pre_push`, and none of the keys this release stopped reading

tests.body:
def test_the_config_is_the_gate_shape(tmp_path, layout):
    root = _project(tmp_path, layout)
    _apply(root)
    config = json.loads(_read(root, '.purlin/config.json'))
    assert config['version'] == VERSION
    assert config['gate'] == 'tested'
    assert config['ai_review_at'] == 'never'
    assert config['min_strength'] == 50
    assert config['mutation_engine'] == 'auto'
    assert config['sql_engine'] is None
    assert config['ci'] == 'github'
    assert config['pre_push'] in ('on', 'off')
tests.name: test_retired_keys_are_gone[upgrade-0.10-dev]
